title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 6) Order 2012

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 6) Order 2012.

2.—(1) Fortis Global Healthcare Infrastructure Pte Ltd is hereby granted exemption from tax on interest derived in India from investments made in compulsory convertible debentures issued by the entities listed in the Schedule, and received in Singapore on or after 26th September 2012.
(2) The exemption under sub-paragraph (1) is subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 26th September 2012 addressed to the tax agent of Fortis Global Healthcare Infrastructure Pte Ltd.
